output.question: What is Best Buy's annual revenue?
output.answer: Best Buy's most recent full fiscal year is fiscal 2026, the twelve months ended January 31, 2026. Revenue for that year was $41.691 billion, up slightly from $41.528 billion in fiscal 2025. Fourth-quarter revenue was $13.814 billion, down from $13.948 billion a year earlier. For fiscal 2027, which ends around January 2027, Best Buy expects revenue of $41.2 billion to $42.1 billion.

key_facts.fact: FY26 revenue (twelve months ended Jan 31, 2026) was $41,691 million, compared with $41,528 million in FY25.
Q4 FY26 revenue was $13,814 million, compared with $13,948 million in Q4 FY25.
FY27 revenue outlook is $41.2 billion to $42.1 billion.
A news report also gives full-year revenue as $41.69bn, up from $41.52bn.

passages.publisher: Best Buy press release (via Seeking Alpha / Business Wire)

passages.quote: For the full year, revenue was $41.69bn, up from $41.52bn.
Enterprise revenue for Q4 FY26 totalled $13.81bn, compared with $13.94bn in the quarter ending 1 February 2025.

caveats: This is the latest full fiscal year (FY26, ended Jan 31, 2026). FY27 is still in progress, and its Q3 results are expected in late November 2026, so a trailing-twelve-month figure as of today may differ a little.

The FY26 and Q4 dollar figures came from a page summary of the press release republished on Seeking Alpha. The primary PDF on Best Buy's investor site could not be read because its text is compressed, and Business Wire returned a 403 error.
The search snippet's Q4 prior-year figure of $13.94bn is the rounded form of $13,948 million.
